label: A distinct cause of a thing's esse giving it being whenever it is present is depended on for being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (sustaining sibling of 2068f91c): in the given model, if c, distinct from x, causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse, DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION at esse, tenseless) and, in every history of the model, gives x being at every moment at which x is present (GivesAt on the STRICT esse-giving reading of definition 158301bc; the time profile of the sustaining cause of being without its presence clause), then x depends for its being on c (DependsForBeing x c, DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING: x would not be if c were not; a primitive parameter, not time-indexed). The tenseless causing and the giving profile are two separate conditions; nothing here passes from one to the other. It is 2068f91c with an added antecedent, so 2068f91c entails it (registered strength order); strictly weaker (Control part 1: in a parent-child interpretation the originating parent gives being at its child's first moment only, so the antecedent fails and the sibling holds vacuously while 2068f91c fails with dependence read as co-presence). Derived from the contact principle c4661518 and the co-presence bridge; with the weak sustaining reading ce55210c it gives 2068f91c back. A cause that only originates its effect does not satisfy its antecedent, so the origin-without-sustaining counterexample does not target it.
